# GNK ASG — Homepage Review Before Publication

Status: locked preparation. This file is not part of the public portal build.

## Reviewed public homepage structure

The current homepage already has a strong corporate flow:

1. Hero: GNK ASG corporate identity and tagline.
2. Corporate profile card.
3. Financial profile.
4. GNK DINAMO Ltd. group overview.
5. Technology and AI section.
6. Digital exchange monitor.
7. Business and technology news.
8. Intelligence Desk.
9. Documents and sources.
10. Footer contact and navigation.

## Main conclusion

Do not redesign the homepage before the first publication. The existing structure is already broad and functional. The safer approach is to add new publication functionality behind internal pages first.

## What should not change before first publication

- Hero section.
- Main headline.
- Financial profile cards.
- Group overview section.
- Existing market monitor.
- Existing news section.
- Existing documents section.
- Overall color/design identity.

## Possible minimal improvements later

### 1. Menu refinement only

Potentially add one menu item later:

- Insights

But only after the Insights archive has at least one complete and reviewed public article.

### 2. Latest Insight compact card

After the first article is public and tested, add one small latest-insight card below the current hero CTA area or near Business News.

Do not place it above the main corporate story.

### 3. Desk prompt improvement

The Intelligence Desk section could later include clearer suggested questions, such as:

- Explain GNK ASG financial profile
- Open public documents
- Show latest insight
- Explain GNK DINAMO Ltd. group framework

This can improve usability without changing the homepage design.

### 4. Document source clarity

The documents section could later add small trust labels:

- Public document
- Independent audit
- Management-certified group report
- External corporate information

This improves clarity without visual redesign.

### 5. Mobile menu check

Before adding any new item, confirm the mobile menu remains readable and does not become too crowded.

## Personal layer rule

The homepage already mentions the personal layer through director, UBO and group context. Do not increase personal prominence on the homepage. Stronger detail belongs to internal profile, author and article pages.

## First publication placement rule

The first publication should be created as an internal article page first. Do not change the homepage until:

- article is complete;
- image is complete;
- metadata is complete;
- desktop preview is checked;
- mobile preview is checked;
- links are working;
- publication is approved.

## Recommendation

Before first publication, keep the homepage unchanged. Prepare the article route, image, metadata and share drafts. After successful review, decide whether to add a discreet menu item or a compact latest-insight card.
